steps.en: Add the package and native prerequisites to your local application
steps.zh: 给本地应用加入包与原生依赖

steps.en: Define file and domain rules, then initialize the runtime
steps.zh: 定义文件和域名规则，再初始化运行时

steps.en: Starts host-side filtering proxies and prepares the session
steps.zh: 启动宿主过滤代理，准备会话

steps.en: Wrap your command, then spawn the returned shell string
steps.zh: 包装命令，再执行返回的命令字符串

steps.en: Applies native file rules and mediates network destinations
steps.zh: 应用原生文件规则，检查网络目标

steps.en: The child runs with restrictions and returns output and an exit code
steps.zh: 子进程在限制下运行，返回输出和退出码

value.en: Existing local tools run under your policy without preparing a guest image
value.zh: 现有本地工具按你的规则运行，不必准备客体镜像
